unit-000.en: A storyteller's idealized tableau on a dark wooden table: an ornate purple-gold alms bowl, a sealed imperial pass on silk, a folding fan and a cup of tea, warm lamp light, the legendary version of a journey, vertical still life.

unit-001.en: A cold Tang dynasty frontier archive at night: a clerk's desk with bamboo slips, sealed warrants and a bronze paperweight, one arrest notice lying open under moonlight through a lattice window, dust suspended in the air.

unit-002.en: Turkic cavalry silhouettes on the horizon beyond a Tang frontier pass, beacon smoke rising from watchtowers, soldiers on the ramparts, wind-torn banners, late afternoon dust, wide vertical vista.

unit-003.en: A dim government office: a young monk's petition on a desk, an official's brush laid across it unread, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya standing small at the threshold before tall shelves of records, grey light.

unit-004.en: Before dawn in a monastery courtyard, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya sits alone on frost-covered stone steps, prayer beads in his hand, eyes fixed on the distant gate, blue hour stillness.

unit-005.en: A scripture hall argument: two senior monks gesture sharply across a low table piled with scrolls, younger monks listening in rows, shafts of dusty light from high windows, doctrinal division.

unit-006.en: Sun-baked farmland in Guanzhong with cracked earth and dry millet stalks, carts of grain outside a relief granary in the distance, officials directing a queue of travelers, pale sky, quiet endurance.

unit-007.en: A crowded city gate at dusk: a stream of famine refugees in ragged clothes, among them the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya with his head lowered and a bundle on his back, slipping past guards in the dust.

unit-008.en: A desert post station at night: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya changes horses, a fresh mount led out, an oil lamp swinging, a frontier wall and watchtower behind, cold stars, urgency.

unit-009.en: A frontier governor's office in lamplight: a sealed arrest warrant pinned beside a map of the western roads, a bronze seal and brush on the desk, the shadow of window bars across the wall.

unit-010.en: In a private back hall, a Tang magistrate in dark official robes tears a sealed warrant in half, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya standing before him in travel-stained robes, a single candle between them, tense and humane.

unit-011.en: A vast Gobi at dusk with five isolated beacon towers strung across the horizon, each with a small spring below, no vegetation, arrow slits and watchmen silhouettes, immense empty sky.

unit-012.en: A ruined temple courtyard: a Hu frontier guide in a fur-trimmed leather coat with a curved knife kneels before the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya to receive ordination, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane tied nearby, incense smoke and late sun.

unit-013.en: Night at the desert edge: a Hu frontier guide in a fur-trimmed leather coat with a curved knife crouches by a small fire, face torn between fear and calculation, hand on his knife, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya sitting calm beyond the flames, cold blue wind.

unit-014.en: Moonlit desert camp: a Hu frontier guide in a fur-trimmed leather coat with a curved knife stands over the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya, who sits calmly with both hands empty and resting on his knees; only the guide holds a drawn short knife, body bent, circling, long shadows on sand, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane watching, cold blade light, no gore.

unit-015.en: An extreme close view of a short knife blade trembling in the dark, moonlight running along the edge, a blurred ember behind, grains of sand drifting in the wind.

unit-016.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya sits upright facing west in open desert, robes straightened, eyes closed, prayer beads moving through his fingers; the knife-wielding silhouette stands a few paces away, cold moonlight, immense stillness.

unit-017.en: Two figures frozen in a night standoff on the sand, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya seated in meditation, a Hu frontier guide in a fur-trimmed leather coat with a curved knife standing with a lowered knife, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane between them, stars and wind, tension like a drawn string.

unit-018.en: Grey dawn on the Gobi: a Hu frontier guide in a fur-trimmed leather coat with a curved knife sheathes his knife, bows with hands clasped, then leads his horse away; the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya stands watching, thin light on their faces, tracks in the sand.

unit-019.en: An immense desert under a huge sky, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya with a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane walking west, tiny against the dunes, long shadows, dust haze, vertical composition emphasizing solitude.

unit-020.en: Night at the base of a Tang beacon tower: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya crouches by a spring filling a water bag, arrows strike the sand around him, soldiers with bows above in torchlight, alarm.

unit-021.en: Inside a beacon tower room, a Tang colonel in leather armor pours tea for the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya, a map between them, his finger pointing to a route around two towers, lamplight, guarded sympathy.

unit-022.en: At the fourth beacon, a Buddhist frontier officer presses the hands of the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya in farewell, a small sutra charm on the table, night wind and torchlight, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane waiting outside.

unit-023.en: An endless sea of dunes under a white-hot sky, no birds, only old camel bones and bleached skulls, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya and a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane small at the center, heat shimmer, desolation.

unit-024.en: A wall of yellow sandstorm swallows the desert, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya pulling his robe over his face, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane turning away, sun blazing through dust, dramatic apocalyptic light.

unit-025.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya on horseback fumbles at a leather water bag, fingers trembling; the bag slips and falls toward the sand in a puff of dust, his cracked lips and desperate eyes.

unit-026.en: Spilled water darkens and vanishes into scorching sand, steam rising, the empty leather bag lying flat, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya standing over the dry stain, pitiless noon light.

unit-027.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya on his knees in the vast desert, hands empty, head bowed; a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane stands over him, ribs showing, heat waves, a sense of physiological dread, no gore.

unit-028.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya yanks the reins around, the head of a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane pulled sideways, dust kicking up, his face set with shame and fear, westward dunes behind him.

unit-029.en: a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane gallops through deep sand toward the east, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya bent low over its neck, a long trail of hoofprints behind, urgent motion, dust cloud, low sun.

unit-030.en: On a knife-edge dune ridge, the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya hauls a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane to a stop; below, a line of hoofprints leads back the way he came; wind-driven sand, vast empty horizon, a moment of decision.

unit-031.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya stands beside a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane on the ridge, head bowed, one hand pressed to his chest, wind tearing at his robe, the eastward tracks visible below, conscience and shame.

unit-032.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya stands alone on a wind-scoured dune top, one hand raised toward the west in a vow, head bowed, robe whipping in the wind, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane standing by, dusk light, remorse turning to resolve.

unit-033.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya turns a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane back toward the west and steps into deepening sand, his back to the east, wind erasing the old tracks, resolve in his posture.

unit-034.en: the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya collapsed beside a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane under a freezing night sky, lips cracked, eyes sunken, the animal lying down to shelter him, immense stars, frost on the sand.

unit-035.en: At dawn in a low hollow, a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane tugs at the sleeve of the lean Chinese monk with a shaved head, sun-darkened skin and a worn ochre kasaya toward a patch of green grass and a small spring; he crawls forward, hands reaching the water, first light.

unit-036.en: A torch-lit road to a Central Asian palace, envoys bowing, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya arriving with a gaunt reddish-brown horse with a shaggy mane, high mud-brick walls, silk banners, night sky, grandeur.

unit-037.en: Inside a richly painted Gaochang hall, a stout Central Asian king in a brocade robe personally offers a tray of food to the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya, attendants kneeling, lamplight and silk, tense courtesy.

unit-038.en: a stout Central Asian king in a brocade robe stands at the head of the hall, one hand on a sword hilt, gesturing to guards at the door; the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya sits calm at a low table, the room divided by shadow.

unit-039.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya alone before a table laden with gold, silk and delicacies, the king's offer spread out; his hands rest empty in his lap, candlelight, moral weight.

unit-040.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya looks steadily at a stout Central Asian king in a brocade robe and speaks, one hand open; the king's face hardens; painted walls and a gilded Buddha behind them, low warm light.

unit-041.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya sits in full lotus in a bare chamber, food trays untouched at the door, his face grown gaunt, a single high window casting hard light on the floor.

unit-042.en: a stout Central Asian king in a brocade robe rushes into the chamber, courtiers behind him, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya slumped but upright, lips black, face grey; the king's composure breaking, dawn light.

unit-043.en: a stout Central Asian king in a brocade robe kneels at the bedside and bows his head in apology, the thin hand of the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya resting on the coverlet, the chamber soft with morning light, relief and shame.

unit-044.en: A long caravan assembles outside the Gaochang gate: thirty horses, twenty attendants, bundles of silk and sealed letters, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya in new robes at the head, dawn dust.

unit-045.en: A column of tiny figures crossing a vast glacier wall, blue ice cliffs and snow bridges, crevasses below, wind plumes, scale and danger, cold palette.

unit-046.en: At a cave camp in the ice, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya kneels beside a frozen companion wrapped in cloth, exhausted men and horses behind, grey light, grief without gore.

unit-047.en: After four years of travel, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya stands before the great gateway of Nalanda monastery, brick towers and monks descending the steps, warm Indian light, arrival.

unit-048.en: An ancient Indian abbot with a white beard, one hundred and six years old, seated on a low throne, tears on his cheeks as he reaches toward the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya, young monks watching, lamplight.

unit-049.en: In a dim library, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya reads a palm-leaf manuscript by oil lamp, surrounded by stacks of bundled leaves, gesturing in argument with invisible opponents, deep concentration.

unit-050.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya traces a line on an old palm-leaf manuscript under a small oil lamp, dust motes in the light, night stillness, a sense of resolution.

unit-051.en: A vast Indian assembly ground beside a river: eighteen kings under canopies, thousands of monks and scholars seated in tiers, banners, elephants, hazy golden light, enormous scale.

unit-052.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya hangs a silk-covered panel at the gate of the assembly, a crowd watching, the panel turned away from view, torchlight, a formal challenge.

unit-053.en: The assembly hall over many days: rows of seated scholars in silence, the silk panel at the center, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya standing alone before it, no one rising, long shadows.

unit-054.en: Kings and monks bow before the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya, silk scarves and gold offerings presented, he receives them with a slight bow, warm dusk light, triumph without arrogance.

unit-055.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya stands on the assembly steps looking back at the crowd, a young man's journey written in his weathered face, banners and dust, quiet pride.

unit-056.en: In a monastery cell, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya packs bundled palm-leaf manuscripts into wooden boxes, a caravan waiting outside, he does not look at the gifts behind him, dawn light.

unit-057.en: The great Zhuque Gate of Chang'an crowded with citizens, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya and a caravan of scriptures entering, officials and monks in procession, banners, spring haze, scale.

unit-058.en: In the Luoyang Yiluan Hall, the Tang emperor in dark gold-trimmed robes questions the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya, maps of the western regions spread on a low table, courtiers at a distance, lamplight and authority.

unit-059.en: The emperor offers a seal of office on a lacquered tray; the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya raises one hand in refusal, the two men alone in a vast hall, moonlight and candlelight, quiet resolve.

unit-060.en: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya sits at a plain desk with brush and paper, dawn light through a lattice window, stacks of manuscripts, his face at peace, a simple cell.

unit-061.en: A new translation hall at Ci'en Temple under construction, scaffolding and craftsmen, imperial commissioners presenting plans, the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya bowing in thanks, spring light.

unit-062.en: Late night in the translation hall: the weathered Chinese monk with a shaved head and a travel-stained ochre kasaya, now aged with grey stubble and deep lines, writes at a worn desk by a single lamp, stacks of finished manuscripts around him, snow beyond the window, one continuous scene, quiet endurance.

unit-063.en: Close view of an aged monk's ink-stained sleeve and a brush resting beside a sheet of paper, a small oil lamp, stacks of bound manuscripts, deep night, quiet discipline.

unit-064.en: A quiet chamber, the aged, gaunt Chinese monk with a shaved head and a patched ochre kasaya lies on a simple bed, robes folded, disciples kneeling, cold winter light, serenity, no distress.

unit-065.en: A vast procession of people in white robes outside the walls of Chang'an, moving slowly toward the Zhongnan Mountains under a grey sky, banners lowered, immense scale, collective grief.

unit-066.en: A plain empty desert ridge at dusk, a single set of footprints and hoofprints, no gods or weapons in the sky, only wind and sand, austere realism.

unit-067.en: The silhouette of the aged, gaunt Chinese monk with a shaved head and a patched ochre kasaya on a dune at dusk, one hand raised as if remembering a slap, the vast desert behind, footprints leading west, timeless closure.
